description: PutnamBench: 1,709 Putnam Mathematical Competition problems (1962–2023) formalised in Lean 4, Rocq, and Isabelle. Proof bodies are left as sorry/admitted/oops placeholders — the benchmark tests proof synthesis.

rocq.name: Rocq (Coq) / MathComp
rocq.note: 412 problems; subset of lean4 problems that have a Rocq statement
